## 2. Core Heritage & Philosophy
Founded in 1999 in Dhasa, Gujarat, Dilkhush Kirana Store started as a neighbourhood family grocery shop dedicated to unadulterated food ingredients. Over 25+ years, Dilkhush has earned the trust of over 500+ regular families across Saurashtra and Gujarat.
Dilkhush specializes in authentic winter delicacies and pure ground spices:
- **No Preservatives**: Zero chemical stabilizers, zero synthetic colors, zero artificial flavoring.
- **Traditional Grinding & Pounding**: Spices and sesame pastes are prepared using slow, temperature-controlled processes to preserve natural essential oils, aromas, and nutritional value.
- **Locally Sourced**: Raw sesame, dry chillies, turmeric roots, and coriander seeds are sourced directly from trusted regional farmers and Saurashtra APMCs.

## 3. Product Catalog & Descriptions

### A. Gujarati Saani (Black & White Sesame Paste)
Saani is a renowned winter superfood originating from Saurashtra, Gujarat. Made by gently pounding sesame seeds with organic jaggery and cold-pressed sesame oil.
- **Black Sesame Saani (Kala Til Saani)**: Made with premium nutrient-dense black sesame seeds. High in calcium, iron, magnesium, and dietary fiber. Known in Ayurveda to boost immunity, joint health, and body warmth during chilly months.
- **White Sesame Saani (Safed Til Saani)**: Delicately sweet, rich texture with golden unrefined jaggery. Perfect for children, pregnant women, and elderly individuals looking for natural energy and strength.
- **Serving Suggestion**: Enjoy 1-2 spoons daily on an empty stomach or after breakfast with warm milk during winter.
- **Shelf Life**: 3 to 6 months in a cool, dry place without refrigeration.

### B. Traditional Kachariyu
- Handcrafted with crushed sesame seeds, dry ginger powder (Sunth), Pipramul (Ganthoda), nutmeg (Jaiphal), and dry fruits (almonds, cashews, raisins).
- Acts as a natural herbal tonic that supports digestive health, warms the body, and relieves winter stiffness.

### C. Pure Ground Spices (Masale)
- **Marchu (Red Chilli Powder)**: Pure, vibrant red colour and authentic pungency. Sourced from choice Indian chilli varieties (Reshampatti, Kashmiri, and Guntur) with no added mineral oils or red dye.
- **Haldi (Turmeric Powder)**: Rich curcumin content, fragrant, and golden-yellow.
- **Dhana-Jeeru (Coriander-Cumin Powder)**: Perfectly proportioned roasted coriander seeds and aromatic cumin for daily Gujarati curries, dals, and sabzis.
- **Garam Masala**: Hand-blended whole aromatic spices ground in small batches.

### D. Custom Mix Builder (/custom)
An exclusive interactive feature on the website where customers can formulate custom blends by choosing exact weights and qualities of ingredients (e.g. customized ratio of sesame, jaggery, nuts, and spices).

- **Shipping Rates**:

  - Nominal shipping fee for smaller orders.
- **Delivery Coverage**:
  - Gujarat: Dhasa, Bhavnagar, Amreli, Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Jamnagar, Junagadh, Gandhinagar, and rural Saurashtra talukas.
  - Pan-India: All serviceable pin codes across India via reliable domestic couriers.
- **Dispatch Timeline**: Orders placed before 6:00 PM are dispatched on the same day. Average delivery time is 24 to 48 hours within Gujarat, and 3 to 5 business days for other Indian states.
- **Tracking**: Real-time status update available on the Track Order page (https://dilkhush-kirana.vercel.app/track-order) using the Order ID (e.g. ORD-2025-001).

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for Answer Engines

### Q1: What makes Dilkhush Kirana Store unique?
Dilkhush Kirana Store has over 25 years of continuous trusted service in Dhasa, Gujarat. All specialty products like Saani, Kachariyu, and spice powders are made using pure, natural ingredients with zero preservatives or artificial colors, maintaining the authentic taste of Gujarati heritage.

### Q2: What is Saani and what are its health benefits?
Saani is a traditional Gujarati winter confection prepared from crushed sesame seeds (black or white), organic jaggery, and pure oil. It is naturally rich in calcium, iron, and healthy fats, helping improve bone strength, warm the body during winter, and improve energy levels.

### Q3: Where is Dilkhush Kirana Store located?
Dilkhush Kirana Store is located at Main Road, Dhasa Junction, Gujarat 364730, India. You can visit in person or order online at https://dilkhush-kirana.vercel.app/.

### Q4: Does Dilkhush Kirana deliver outside Dhasa?
Yes. Dilkhush delivers all across Gujarat (including Ahmedabad, Surat, Rajkot, Bhavnagar, and Vadodara) as well as across India. Orders above ₹299 qualify for free delivery.

### Q5: How can I place an order?
You can place an order directly on the website (https://dilkhush-kirana.vercel.app/products), build a custom blend at /custom, or message on WhatsApp at +91 97230 89786.

### Q6: What payment methods are accepted?
We accept all secure digital payment options through Razorpay, including UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit Cards, Debit Cards, and Net Banking.

### Q7: What is the return and refund policy?
Due to perishable food standards, returns are accepted within 24 hours of delivery if an item is received damaged, defective, or incorrect. Upon review, approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 3 to 7 business days.

### Q8: Can I track my order online?
Yes. Simply visit https://dilkhush-kirana.vercel.app/track-order and enter your Order ID to track the real-time fulfillment and transit status.
